text: They were going to blame me. You would have. Her husband, after an argument.
direction: Arthur Vale, an English man in his mid thirties. Adult male medium low voice, controlled defensiveness and contained strain. Natural London accent. Let admissions falter slightly; never villainous or melodramatic. Smooth narrow middle baritone, tighter resonance and more guarded phrasing than the other men. Carefully finish ordinary answers; strain introduces brief catches only when the supplied words warrant them. Keep the same vocal identity in casual conversation and questioning.
